relay.transcript.turn.condensed.note: Used only when the model supplies no more specific segment label.

relay.transcript.turn.took.note: {duration} is already formatted, for example 31s or 2m14s. Never claim a duration when absent.

relay.transcript.turn.actions.note: {label} is the formatted count, including a trailing + when the loaded history is partial. Translate the complete plural message; do not print {count} separately.

relay.transcript.turn.completed.note: Appended to a completed condensed bar's accessible name.

relay.transcript.fold.unit.note: One complete unit per kind. shell, python and {name} are runtime/tool names and stay untranslated. The other arm formats a raw tool name; preserve placeholders and plural/select syntax exactly.

relay.transcript.fold.shell.note: shell is a runtime tool category and stays untranslated. Use the locale's number formatting and plural rules; the noun remains shell in every arm.

relay.transcript.fold.python.note: python is a runtime tool category and stays untranslated. Use the locale's number formatting and plural rules; the noun remains python in every arm.

relay.transcript.fold.more.note: Follows at most five count units and counts actions hidden by that display cap, not additional tool types.

relay.transcript.fold.failed_label.note: Screen-reader text accompanying the failure glyph; it does not claim a count.

relay.transcript.fold.partial_label.note: Explains that N+ is a minimum because earlier history has not loaded.

relay.transcript.older.failed.note: Shown beside the existing Try again action at the top of the transcript.

relay.transcript.label.steered.note: The segment followed a steering message.

relay.transcript.label.wake.note: The segment followed a scheduled wake.

relay.transcript.label.peer.note: The segment followed a peer message.

relay.transcript.label.job.note: The segment followed a background job result.

relay.transcript.label.ask.note: The segment contains a settled operator question.

relay.transcript.label.messages.note: Used when receipts from multiple families form one quiet group.

relay.transcript.composer.queued.note: Restores the pre-redesign queued-prompt count; {count} is the number of prompts waiting, not tool calls.

relay.transcript.session.unread_refused.note: Explains that unread state could not be read and that no messages were marked read. Used by both bulk and row-level mark operations.
